exercises.name: 1. Assault Bike or Row Erg
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raise. Nasal breathing if possible, gradually build warmth.

exercises.name: 2a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Max intent on each rep. Stick soft landings. Rest 45–60 sec.

exercises.name: 2b. Medicine Ball Chest Pass
exercises.notes: Explosive, chest-height throw. Reset between reps. Use 3–5 kg / 7–11 lb ball.

exercises.name: 3. Back Squat
exercises.notes: RPE 6–7, 2–3 RIR. Controlled 2–0–1 tempo. Full range with solid bracing.

exercises.name: 4. Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: RPE 7, 2 RIR. Lower under control, press smoothly. Keep shoulders packed.

exercises.name: 5. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: RPE 7, 2 RIR. Pull elbows toward hips, pause briefly at top.

exercises.name: 6. Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: RPE 6–7. Soft knees, hinge at hips, feel hamstrings. Do not turn this into a deadlift.

exercises.name: 7a. Walking Lunge
exercises.notes: Bodyweight or light dumbbells. Long stride, upright torso, smooth control.

exercises.name: 7b. Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: RPE 7. Pull to upper chest, avoid swinging.

exercises.name: 8a. Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Only roll as far as trunk stays braced. Slow out, controlled return.

exercises.name: 8b. Plate Neck Flexion + Extension
exercises.notes: Light load only. Smooth tempo, no jerking.

exercises.name: 9. Zone 2 Bike
exercises.notes: Moderate steady pace at RPE 5–6. Finish feeling fresher, not drained.

exercises.name: 1. Assault Bike or Row Erg
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raise. Nasal breathing if possible, gradually build warmth.

exercises.name: 2a. Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Explode forward, land balanced, reset each rep. Rest 60 sec.

exercises.name: 2b. Medicine Ball Rotational Scoop Throw
exercises.notes: Rotate through hips and torso. Fast release, full intent.

exercises.name: 3. Back Squat
exercises.notes: Add a small load from week 1 if all sets were solid. RPE 7, 2 RIR.

exercises.name: 4. Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: RPE 7–8, 1–2 RIR. Add reps before load if unsure.

exercises.name: 5. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: RPE 7–8. Keep chest fixed to pad, no momentum.

exercises.name: 6. Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Slightly heavier than week 1 if technique stays crisp. RPE 7.

exercises.name: 7a. Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Bodyweight or light dumbbells. Stay tall and control the bottom.

exercises.name: 7b. Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: RPE 7–8. Full stretch at top, pull elbows down.

exercises.name: 8a. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Hold plate at chest. Move under control, avoid excessive hip yank.

exercises.name: 8b. Plate Neck Lateral Flexion
exercises.notes: Light load only. Smooth motion, no shrugging.

exercises.name: 9. Zone 2 Bike
exercises.notes: Moderate steady pace at RPE 5–6.

exercises.name: 1. Assault Bike or Row Erg
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raise. Nasal breathing if possible, gradually build warmth.

exercises.name: 2a. Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height that allows clean landings. Step down each rep.

exercises.name: 2b. Medicine Ball Shot-Put Throw
exercises.notes: Boxing-specific intent. Drive from rear hip, fast hand finish.

exercises.name: 3. Back Squat
exercises.notes: RPE 7–8, 1–2 RIR. Add load if week 2 moved well.

exercises.name: 4. Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: RPE 8. Controlled descent, powerful press.

exercises.name: 5. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Slightly heavier than week 2. Pause briefly at top.

exercises.name: 6. Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: RPE 7–8. Keep lats tight and bar close to legs.

exercises.name: 7a. Walking Lunge
exercises.notes: Use light to moderate dumbbells if available. Stay balanced.

exercises.name: 7b. Pull-Up or Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Use assistance as needed to keep clean reps and full range.

exercises.name: 8a. Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Brace hard. Stop before lower back extends.

exercises.name: 8b. Plate Neck Flexion + Extension
exercises.notes: Light load, smooth reps, no rushing.

exercises.name: 9. Zone 2 Bike
exercises.notes: Moderate steady pace at RPE 5–6. Keep breathing controlled.

exercises.name: 1. Assault Bike or Row Erg
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raise. Keep this deload week relaxed.

exercises.name: 2a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Fast and crisp. Lower total volume this week.

exercises.name: 2b. Medicine Ball Chest Pass
exercises.notes: Explosive but relaxed. Stop every set with reps in reserve.

exercises.name: 3. Back Squat
exercises.notes: RPE 6. Reduce load about 10–15% from week 3.

exercises.name: 4. Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: RPE 6–7. Smooth reps, no grinding.

exercises.name: 5. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: RPE 6–7. Keep movement strict.

exercises.name: 6. Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: RPE 6. Easy hinge practice and hamstring stimulus.

exercises.name: 7a. Bodyweight Split Squat
exercises.notes: Controlled range, easy effort.

exercises.name: 7b. Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Moderate load, leave 3 reps in reserve.

exercises.name: 8a. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Use lighter load than week 3. Controlled tempo.

exercises.name: 8b. Plate Neck Lateral Flexion
exercises.notes: Very light load, smooth and easy.

exercises.name: 9. Zone 2 Bike
exercises.notes: Easy flush at RPE 4–5. Finish fresh.
